title: Two-scale semigroup criterion for the normalized Green trace
question: Can the finite Mellin bridge be reorganized as a two-scale semigroup criterion that isolates a short-time UV power budget from a late-time IR gap budget, and thereby expose the exact uniform inputs needed for a Green-trace bound?
method: For every actual conditional likelihood row, form the normalized intrinsic Laplacian and sort its positive spectrum.
Enumerate all 25 declared R-412 IR/UV exponent pairs and every interior split on the complete row grid.
Use A_tau=r tau^alpha_UV+C_UV alpha_UV Gamma(alpha_UV) to bound the short-time heat trace by A_tau t^(-alpha_UV) for 0<t<=tau.
Use gamma=lambda_1 to check H(t)<=H(tau) exp(-gamma(t-tau)) for t>=tau and integrate the late budget H(tau)/gamma.
Check the exact finite Mellin decomposition and the resulting Green-trace criterion for every candidate profile.
Repeat the full grid in an independent plain-loop implementation and apply IR/UV omission, wrong-gap, wrong-shift, late-term omission, time-order, sign and alpha=1 hostile mutations.
finding: The primary lane passes 191471/191471 assertions over 7 systems, 2688 contexts and 21120 conditional rows. The independent lane passes 191470/191470 on the same grid, the hostile lane passes 9/9, the integrated verifier passes 42/42, and Lean R414 compiles. The first-positive-gap range is [0.7570174175402339,5.647863075935399], the split-time heat range is [0.0036012445961644186,0.5926882083380163], the minimum Green-bound slack is 2.936364851149518, and the maximum Mellin residual is 3.885780586188048e-16.
decision_reason: The short/late semigroup split turns the mixed spectral envelope into a single explicit Green-trace criterion. It separates the ultraviolet coefficient from the infrared gap and makes the missing uniformity premises auditable, while the finite rows do not establish any regulator-independent constant.

adversarial_review.check: A head-heavy five-mode toy gives a short-budget deficit 0.11755608825868386 when the finite IR head is omitted.
A tail-heavy four-mode toy gives a short-budget deficit 0.13507226908622838 when the UV integral term is omitted.
Using the largest eigenvalue instead of the first positive gap gives a late-budget deficit 2.920502936517768.
Dropping H(tau)/gamma gives a Green-trace deficit 0.4775461490944841 on the exact two-mode toy.
Using exp(-gamma(t+tau)) instead of exp(-gamma(t-tau)) gives a deficit 2.7432509056332397.
Reversing the heat-time grid creates an increase 0.2894603181637101.
Changing the exact split to short-minus-late leaves residual 6.239564084015606.
alpha=1 is rejected before an integral budget is formed.
Finite positivity of A_tau, gamma and H(tau) does not imply cutoff/volume/source/phase/exhaustion uniformity, a common core, GNS coercivity, a physical gap, continuum, C6, Sector-A or Pre-A closure.

qft_interface.closed: Finite short-time UV power envelope, late-time IR semigroup envelope, integrated Green-trace criterion, full row coverage, hostile shortcut rejection and Lean scalar bookkeeping.
qft_interface.open: Uniform split time and UV coefficient, positive uniform intrinsic gap and split heat value on a Hamiltonian common core, R-399 shell transfer, R-406 Schur combination, OS/KMS/GNS reconstruction, continuum and physical-gap obligations.

next_action: Prove a source/cutoff/volume/phase/exhaustion-uniform bound for A_tau, gamma and H(tau) on one Hamiltonian common core; transfer both budgets to the R-399 shell and combine them with the R-406 harmonic/Schur residual. If gamma collapses under a validated growing stress, retain only the UV half and record the route-local obstruction.
boundary: T0 claim-nonbearing finite two-scale semigroup bridge only. It proves no cutoff-, volume-, source-, phase- or exhaustion-uniform coefficient or gap, common core, common split rule, OS/KMS/GNS reconstruction, mass gap, continuum, C6, Sector-A or Pre-A closure.
no_overclaim: The two-scale criterion isolates the exact UV coefficient, split-time heat value and IR gap required by a future uniform proof; it does not supply those regulator-independent premises or a physical-sector conclusion.
